line.en: the bergen julemarked on festplassen is open 10:00 to 21:00 on sundays, free entry, until 22 december. first sunday of advent, so a good start.
line.de: der bergener julemarkt auf dem festplassen hat sonntags von 10 bis 21 uhr geöffnet, der eintritt ist frei, bis 22. dezember. erster advent, ein guter start.
line.tr: festplassen'deki bergen julemarkt'i pazar günleri 10:00 ile 21:00 arası açık, giriş ücretsiz, 22 aralık'a kadar sürüyor. ilk advent pazarı, iyi bir başlangıç.

sparks.why: Bergen Julemarked on Festplassen, Sat and Sun 10:00 to 21:00, free entry, 20 Nov to 22 Dec, per Visit Bergen and Visit Norway listings; the 12:00 start is a suggestion. The stalls are a Christmas market, so it is filed under flea.
